task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/podcast.wav loaded (a 12-second mono 44.1 kHz tone).

1. Add a new Label Track via Tracks > Add New > Label Track.
2. Create exactly three labels in that label track:
   - At time 0.0s (at the very beginning) with title: intro
   - At time 4.0s with title: main
   - At time 8.0s with title: outro
   Use Ctrl+B to add a label at the current cursor position, or click into the label track at the desired position. Set the times precisely using the Selection Toolbar.
3. Save the Audacity project to /home/user/Music/podcast.aup using File > Save Project > Save Project As... (accept defaults).
4. Export the label track to /home/user/Music/podcast_labels.txt using File > Export > Export Labels....

Do not export the audio itself — only the labels text file and the .aup project are required outputs.

verification.eval: any(abs(float(l['t']) - 0.0) < 0.15 for l in result if l['title']=='intro') and any(abs(float(l['t']) - 4.0) < 0.15 for l in result if l['title']=='main') and any(abs(float(l['t']) - 8.0) < 0.15 for l in result if l['title']=='outro')

verification.description: Labels text file is non-empty (3 entries > 30 bytes)
